name: San Gimignano (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and yellow, charged at the centre with a white lion rampant bearing a small shield with a fleur-de-lis on blue (the arms of San Gimignano).
history: Municipal flag of San Gimignano, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: lion rampant bearing a small shield with a fleur-de-lis
